capabilities_done: slice 1 NEF: Compression 34713 lossless (0x46) and lossy type 1 (0x44 0x10), type 2 (0x44 0x20/0x40, 257-point interpolated curve) and lossy-after-split at 12/14 bit; decode table from Exif IFD -> MakerNote 'Nikon\0' embedded TIFF tag 0x0096 (seeds, curve, split row, note byte order); src/nefc.rs adapted from LightCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0), routing in src/nef.rs; lossy white = curve maximum; unapplied nef_black_level_unread, nef_white_level_unread; 34713 without the table -> decoder_unavailable:nef_compressed; 32769 unchanged
V4-01 deny(clippy::arithmetic_side_effects) in nefc.rs and nef.rs; V4-02 size check (every code word >= 2 bits) before allocation, dimension-bomb test

slice 2 CR3: decode_container routes ISO-BMFF ftyp 'crx ' to src/cr3.rs (box walk bounded to 4096 boxes / depth 12, first largest CRAW track with CMP1, stsz + co64/stco first sample, CMT1 Model) -> src/crx.rs (CMP1 parse; CRX 0x100 lossless, 0x100 horizontal-tile C-RAW with uniform quantisation, 0x200 single-tile 14-bit C-RAW with adaptive QP map; MED prediction, adaptive Rice, zero-run MELCODE; marker families ff01-03/ff11-13) -> src/crx_wavelet.rs (integer Le Gall 5/3 synthesis); whole stored sensor mosaic incl. masked borders, CMP1 CFA code, full-scale white; unapplied cr3_black_level_unread, cr3_white_level_unread, cr3_active_area_unread; other CRX variants unsupported_compression; adapted from LightCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0), serial, deny(arithmetic_side_effects) in all three modules

slice 3 RAF: decode_container routes FUJIFILMCCD-RAW to src/raf.rs (header pointers at 84..108, compression mode u32 at 108, record directory, X-Trans layout record 0x0131 reversed must equal develop's X-Trans grid else unsupported_pattern, RGGB without it, little-endian TIFF raw block with 0xF000 raw IFD: 0xF001-0xF003 geometry, 0xF007/0xF008 strip; pixel cap before the codec) -> src/rafc.rs (IS header consistency, stripe size table, lossy quantiser tables, per-stripe colour-vector decode with even/odd predictors, 41 folded gradient contexts, fine-precision contexts, adaptive Rice with bounded escape, payload-vs-frame check before allocation); modes 2 lossless and 3 lossy, Bayer and X-Trans, 12/14/16 bit; mode 0 uncompressed -> decoder_unavailable:raf_uncompressed; no TIFF raw block (SuperCCD S5000) -> decoder_unavailable:raf; unapplied raf_black_level_unread, raf_white_level_unread, raf_crop_unread; adapted from LightCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0)

slice 4 ORF: IIRO/IIRS/MMOR routed to src/orf.rs, read as TIFF through a magic-patched copy (container hash over the original bytes); exact two-field 12-bit layout (strips summing to w*h*1.5, one field-seam gap, even rows then odd rows, trailing stored row), MSB-first 12-bit pairs, Exif CFAPattern 0xA302; unapplied orf_black_level_unread, orf_white_level_unread, orf_active_area_unread; other layouts incl. Olympus compressed ORF -> decoder_unavailable:orf; adapted from LightCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0)

slice 5 RW2: IIU routed to src/rw2.rs (magic-patched TIFF copy, Panasonic IFD0 0x0002/0x0003/0x0009/0x000A/0x000B/0x002D/0x0118); 16-bit words (compression 34828/34830), packed formats 2/5/7 (format 5 rotated 0x4000-byte chunks), format 4 (2-bit scales, deferred seeds for mapped-out pixels, rotated chunks) and format 6 (12/14 bit); stream-size check before allocation; unapplied rw2_black_level_unread, rw2_white_level_unread, rw2_borders_unread, rw2_defect_pixels_unfilled; format 8 strips and unknown formats -> decoder_unavailable:rw2; adapted from LightCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0)
NOTICE: LightCraft attribution + MIT terms; DESCRIPTOR scope/pending updated

blockers.error: Olympus compressed ORF (every interchangeable-lens body since ~2008): no permissively licensed decoder or bit-level description found (LightCraft, the only permissive source, refuses it and points only to two Olympus patents); no compressed ORF sample in the corpus, so nothing was downloaded. Typed decoder_unavailable:orf. NOT_PROVEN, not claimed.

Panasonic RW2 raw format 8 (DC-GH6 and later, prefix-coded strips): LightCraft describes and decodes it, but the corpus has no format-8 sample (LX7 is format 4); not built in this lane to keep claims sample-backed. Typed decoder_unavailable:rw2.

Uncompressed RAF (mode 0) and SuperCCD FinePix RAF (S5000, no TIFF raw block): outside this lane's compressed scope / no permissive SuperCCD remap; typed decoder_unavailable:raf_uncompressed and decoder_unavailable:raf.
